en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a steep funicular railway climbing a wooded hillside toward a large building complex at the top. Two funicular cars are visible on parallel tracks, one ascending and one near the bottom. At the summit stands a multi‑storey structure with signs on the facade, and the slope is rocky and forested. The caption at the top reads "Graz. Schloßbergbahn."
